entries.value: "Projects the plan store as a read-only file tree, so an agent reads its plan with cat and ls instead of a CLI grammar (phase-3-store-surfaces-are-filesystems). The projection is PURE - store rows in, relative-path/content pairs out - so its tests run on any host; only materialize() touches a filesystem."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# serde only. Deliberately no SQLite dependency: the projection consumes the JSON that
# `bsc plan get --json` already emits, so this crate never opens plan.db and never pulls the
# DuckDB-shaped part of the workspace into its build.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# examples only. launch.rs composes the projection with the sandbox launcher; the library
# itself stays free of that dependency.
sections.name: [dev-dependencies]
